capabilities: : Apply custom markers to list items
intentEvidence: Trigger-based list and task markers for Obsidian — character or icon badges and line tints in Live Preview and Reading View.
motivation: The author needed a real sense of priority on lists, similar to the Eisenhower Matrix, for their daily workflow.
problem: Users need a way to visually indicate priority or specific status on list items beyond standard bullet points.

relations.evidence: Inspired by List Callouts by mgmeyers.

summary: Markr provides trigger-based list and task markers, allowing users to apply configurable badges and line tints to list items in Live Preview and Reading View.
